name: Colfax County, NE
findings: Colfax County has 34 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Colfax County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Colfax County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
